page.overview:
Who is Harald Ertl?

Harald Ertl (August 31 1948 - April 7 1982) was an Austrian driver and motorsports journalist. He entered 28 races, driving in 19 of them, for , and . Ertl is best remembered as one of the four drivers who came to Niki Lauda's aid at the Nürburgring in 1976.

Ertl died in a light plane crash outside of Giessen, Germany, while on their way to an Easter holiday by the sea. His brother-in-law and niece also died in the crash, but his wife and son survived.
